primary_cases: warranty, inventory, queue, ties; levels 0,1,2: twelve new environments
separate_continuum_cases: fleet0 and fleet1: original controlled affine atoms, horizons 2 and 3, initial 3/4 delta_(1/5)+1/4 delta_(4/5)
methods: witness-regret restart-price and disaggregated simplex products
primary_metric: independently checked method-only absolute target attainment, with zero-cost, root and branching closures separated
comparison: same raw model and common driver; each run constructs its own witnesses and incumbent; not an external-author replication
time_cap_semantics: soft stop between exact certificate operations; report actual all-in time including oracle, incumbent, pricing, tree, encoding, serialization and independent replay
precision: begin at 8 bits, add 8 until computed upper repair and capped-price witness budgets are each at most target/64; no fixed oracle bit ceiling
clipping_proposal: all nonempty initial masks for n<=4; full mask and positive-mass singletons otherwise; stop at registered price budget; no claim of exact clipped optimum for truncated enumeration
branching: widest probability coordinate every fourth level, product defect otherwise; no outcome-dependent retuning
information_boundary: no exact optimal operating DP, saved policies, old prices or old endpoints used at any design stage of a solve
model_generator: deterministic SHA-256 seeds fixed in models.py; no primary model generated before the tested-source freeze commit
financial_units: designed fleet example: 500 dollars per normalized implementation cost; decision thresholds 100,250,500,1000 dollars; no claim of empirical calibration
retention: retain every model, failed/capped run, complete proof, exact check and timing; code changes after observed outcomes require separate amendment and must not replace this evaluation
